summary: Implemented the window title feature. Changes: rich/segment.py adds ControlType.SET_WINDOW_TITLE = 16 and widens ControlCode with Tuple[ControlType, str]. rich/control.py adds the format entry "\x1b]0;{title}\x07" and the Control.title classmethod, which passes one (type, text) tuple. rich/console.py adds set_window_title(title) after show_cursor, gated only on is_terminal, returning True or False, with a Google-style docstring. rich/_windows_renderer.py adds an elif branch that calls term.set_title(title) from the second item. CHANGELOG.md gets an Added bullet under Unreleased linking PR 2200. Tests added: test_set_window_title (test_console.py), test_control_title (test_control.py), test_control_set_window_title (test_windows_renderer.py). Not run: tests and mypy were not executed, per instructions, so everything is unverified. Nothing committed.
